_comment: Behavior config for social monitoring of high-scoring gems. NO SECRETS here — API credentials/tokens live in .env.local (see .env.example). Safe to commit.

thresholds._comment: A gem is tracked on social only when BOTH thresholds are met (AND).

telegram._comment: Worker joins project Telegram channels read-only. Credentials come from TELEGRAM_* in .env.local. USE A SECONDARY PHONE — see scripts/tg-worker/README.md.

x._comment: Twitter/X buzz monitoring via Nitter public RSS — no API key, no account needed. Set source='nitter' to use the free Nitter path (scripts/tg-worker/worker.py). Set source='official' to use the paid X API v2 (needs X_BEARER_TOKEN in .env.local). Set source='none' to disable entirely.
x._source_options: nitter = free Nitter RSS (default); official = X API v2 (needs X_BEARER_TOKEN); none = disabled

watchlist._comment: How long to keep tracking and how many gems to track at once.

spamFilter._comment: Thresholds for the bot/spam filter in src/lib/spam-filter.ts. Scores below botThreshold are treated as spam and suppressed entirely. Scores above it are discounted proportionally by the authenticity score.

telegram._comment: Group-level bot detection thresholds. Signals are tallied from the historySampleSize messages the worker reads.
telegram._minOnlineRatioPct_comment: % of members that should be online (below this → ghost group penalty). Set to 0 to disable.
telegram._maxMsgRatePerMemberPerHour_comment: Messages/hour/member threshold above which the group is flagged as bot-inflated.
telegram._maxForwardedSharePct_comment: % of messages that are forwards before a penalty is applied.
telegram._maxAnonymousSharePct_comment: % of messages from anonymous senders before a penalty is applied.
telegram._maxContractSharePct_comment: % of messages containing a contract address (contract dump channel detection).
telegram._minUniqueSenderRatioPct_comment: % unique senders / total messages. Below this → concentrated bot activity.

x._comment: Account-level bot detection thresholds for X/Twitter signals.
x._maxFollowingFollowerRatio_comment: Following/follower ratio above this → follow-back bot pattern.
x._minAvgEngagementForActive_comment: Average engagement per tweet below this (with ≥10 tweets) → ghost/bot account.
x._maxTweetsPerDay_comment: Tweets/day above this → bot posting rate.
x._newAccountDaysHard_comment: Accounts younger than this (days) get a hard penalty (-30 pts).
x._newAccountDaysSoft_comment: Accounts younger than this (days) get a soft penalty (-15 pts).
